mr-2: romantic, vocal-forward, a little weird; the channel-orange orbit
mr-2: the cleanest out-of-lane move — Frank Ocean's own project; anyone who loves channel orange this hard should get this

bad.reason: in-genre R&B but the playlist-slop pole: auto-tuned, hook-first, none of the genre-blending soul the reviews describe
R&B-pop crossover; a lazy 'pop vocal' read of the profile — the reviews are about R&B that borrows from other genres, not pop that borrows an ad-lib
